title: Review source-ring hand-back cost for short-message streams on i7
body:
## Owner cost judgment for #303 (and the full-stack handoff)

Devon’s physical i7-12700K records show a short-message stream cost of the source-ring ownership fix. The safe protocol must not be reverted to recover timing. John owns protocol/integration and whether to accept the remaining cost; acceptance is not yet recorded here. Keep this issue open while an accepted cost remains.

**Immutable evidence:** [Devon publication bbcea09bfdd6bd824f5cf78c7d8bff3528b6a313](https://github.com/devonjonte/bench-hashes/tree/bbcea09bfdd6bd824f5cf78c7d8bff3528b6a313/2026-11-08/ring-fix-stream-cost-i7), [original report on #303](https://github.com/servil-software-factory/BLAKE3/pull/303#issuecomment-6719400226). I fetched/verified every file’s Git blob/mode/size and both supplied SHA-256/BLAKE3 manifests. Full source identities in every sample header match the sides below; this is Devon’s independent canonical measurement, not a new Sam pinned-run verdict.

- Exact **40985bbc7178b4d879b1ab719aaeb6e5d52db921 vs d4f675f4967317b41546e8c8309d35eb384cbbaf**, bench/clocks **49f45960ff276558e707cb777a357679332788fe**. `check --points "continuous 64 B,continuous 128 B,continuous 256 B,continuous 1 KiB,continuous batch 16"`: four fresh pairs. BLAKE3-Servil mt ContinuousMessages64B **+8.2% Slower** (+8.1/+6.9/+6.9/+10.8%);128B **+5.7% Slower** (+5.3/+7.0/+5.9/+4.5%). Larger named controls Level. No64-pair confirmation claimed.
- Separate direct full endpoint **4f1dd19c83122dfee2c62c1304eb593b812ee992 vs 7ee5c1f8cfad7937fb490e6510f8f36fe5ce912f**, same bench, `--cells all`: mt continuous128B **+6.6% Slower**, four accepted pairs. Raw retried pair remains in `retried/`. This is not a composed stage ratio or proof all of that combined cost has one cause. Whole-cycle small arrivals are38–43% Faster alongside it, not an erasure.

**Attempted alternatives, not accepted fixes:** Devon retains three3-pair probes (CAS in push, next first in TaskSlot, hand-back-store-only control); none clearly removes the cost and no gate verdict is claimed. She reports a no-wait counting probe, but no counting samples are retained; I cannot independently verify that part. No cache/alignment/frequency cause established.

**Ownership map / next useful investigation:** producer writes TaskSlot.task and acquires TaskSlot.next before reuse; the successful CPU claimer copies task then release-stores next; GPU release follows its borrow. All claimers also CAS the claimed counter. These are real ownership transfers, not automatically removable by padding. TaskSlot has Rust layout: native stride/offset/cache-line sharing are not established by source field order or the next-first timing probe. Capture those plus a reproducible count of the taken/wait paths, then let John choose a focused, memory-safe ownership ablation accounting for footprint/copy costs. Do not spin another stress campaign against the old unsafe window or create a competing ring design.

Request explicit acceptance or mitigation beside the safety benefit before promotion; do not classify this as test noise or use previous foundation/startup cost acceptance. Existing #302 correctness and owner Mac/GPU gates remain separate.

— Sam Shackleton
